title: Stated intent
description: Output of the intent-extractor agent: what the pull request description states, one statement per row. An empty list is valid. `check-intent` also requires every quote and reason to be a whole sentence or list item of the description, of at least four words, and every quote except a non-goal's to share a significant word with its statement.

quote.description: The whole sentence or list item of the description that states it, verbatim, at least four words. Whitespace differences and a leading list marker are ignored.

reason.description: The whole sentence or list item where the author gives the reason for the choice, verbatim, at least four words. Required on a deliberate statement, forbidden on any other.

scope.description: Only on a goal that names a set and asserts something about all of it: all menus, every route, links and routes match.
